root_cause: On the JOIN_ERR_FIELD error path (separator or NUL byte inside a field) the 'fail' label clears res->data without freeing the buffer allocated by malloc, so the allocation becomes unreachable: LeakSanitizer reports a direct leak allocated in join_with_sep (src/join.c) for the separator_in_field and nul_in_field test cases.
rationale: Free the partially filled buffer before clearing the result in the shared error path. This releases the allocation on every error exit after malloc, keeps the documented error contract (res->data == NULL, res->len == 0) and does not change the success path.
